+def spaced_delimiter_csv(tmp_path):

+    path.write_text(
+        'name,city,note\n"Doe, John", "Paris, France", frequent traveler\n',
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+    return path
+

+def test_cli_quoted_comma_after_spaced_delimiter(spaced_delimiter_csv):
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, "fmtcsv.py", str(spaced_delimiter_csv)],
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=True,
+    )
